name: Hajimete no Ofuroya-san
original_name: はじめてのおふろやさん
source: Souji is a university student who went back home during the summer vacation, only to discover that there is a foreign girl living in his house. He takes the foreign girl Lena and his childhood friend Miyuki to the men's public bath, where they all will have exciting experiences.
